messages:
eva: quick FYI from the comet-33b onboarding sweep (int3). we see a consistent RoPE phase discontinuity when we expand ctx from 16k->32k if a short system prepend crosses a tile boundary. reproducible on a100 multi-shard.
martin: can you share the short repro and where it flips (layer/token)?
eva: minimal repro: prefill 15980 tokens, inject 10-token system msg, gen 600 tokens. flips around token +38 after the inject, layer 5 kv anchor shows +1 offset. seed fixed.
noah: that smells like a packing rollover + rotary interpolation mismatch. int3 uses non-byte-aligned packing so phase math can get slightly off if we recompute positions with different rounding.
eva: pasted small dump:
```
layer5.kv_anchor: expected 0x3fa0, observed 0x3fa1
kv_digest: 0xab12 -> 0xab14
config: model=comet-33b-int3 ctx=32768 prefill_mode=stream
seed=1234
```
qa-bot: run/2026.03.22-int3-onboard started on staging for comet-33b. regression checks queued.
rachel: try toggling ROTARY_MODE=nearest vs linear and PREFILL_STRIDE=64/128. if nearest fixes it it's interpolation related. also run same repro on int4/int8 builds to confirm quant-specific.
eva: quick experiments: PREFILL_STRIDE=64 + KV_ALIGN=1 removed the offset in 5/5 runs. ROTARY_MODE=nearest reduced divergence but didn't fully eliminate it. int4 build showed no flip; fp16 clean.
martin: ok that narrows it to int3 packing + RoPE interplay. action: 1) add a safeguard in loader to enforce tile-aligned prefill stride for quant builds, 2) add a unit test simulating cross-tile prepend, 3) run quant matrix across shard counts. can someone own a short PR?achel: i'll pair with eva on the unit test and open the PR with the alignment fallback. please include the small repro harness used above.
eva: thanks — opening ticket INF-4531 and will post PR link here. attaching golden diffs and a tiny token-divergence summary (0.6% after 600 tokens) in the ticket.
noah: once PR lands let's run full longctx benchmark (8k/16k/32k/48k) across int3/int4/int8 and capture token divergence + ppl delta. i can script the trace comparator.
eva: perfect. i'll follow up with results in this thread. :thumbsup:
